profile.headline: Senior iOS Engineer | Mobile Development
profile.summary:
iOS software engineer with experience building scalable, user-focused applications across finance, healthcare, and HR domains. Strong focus on code quality, architecture, and testing.

Currently building AI skills and exploring how AI can improve developer productivity and software development workflows.

positions.title: Lead iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead development of features for Chase business banking feature Quick Accept.

- Lead Swift 6 migration for Chase business banking feature Quick Accept.    

- Built iOS Invoicing solution for Chase business customers. 

- Enhanced Chase Snapshot and built re-useable tile for Chase Daily Snapshot feature.

- Led a hybrid location technical hackathon by developing an iOS application using ARKIT, securing 2nd place amongst New York teams.
positions.insights: Skills: iOS Development · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Application Architecture · UIKit · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a web application using JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, and Redux. 
•	Create a responsive web experience using CSS Flexbox, CSS Grid, CSS frameworks like Bootstrap and HTML5.  
•	Used Firebase Analytics to integrate API calls within the web application for aiding in learning user behavior based on roles.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop, and Maintain iOS applications for iPad, iPhone, and Apple Watch using Swift and Objective-C. 
•	Implemented biometric FaceID and TouchID authentication using Local Authentication framework and streamlined the login experience.  
•	Created and customized Table Views, Collection Views, and Navigation Bars in a multi-view application using Storyboards. 
•	Followed the Modal View View-Model (MVVM) architectural design pattern to structure code for the application. 
•	Migrated application from Google Analytics to Firebase Analytics and integrated function calls within the iOS application.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed Business Logic for Health Care Data using SQL Programming and Excel Sheets. 
•	Designed and developed SSIS packages for ETL processes and automated data loading from flat files to staged tables onto SQL Server.  
•	Populated medical record information into database staging tables using SQL and business logic templates.
positions.insights: Skills: U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · SQL · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed SharePoint website using JavaScript, HTML5 & CSS3.  
•	Wrote technical articles and participated in technical evangelism for organizing and hosting meetup events.

positions.title: Operating Systems and Data Structures Algoritham Tutor for DeepCS club
positions.description:
- I worked under the DeepCS Computing club at NJIT to provide tutoring of courses to NJIT graduate students in Computer Science. 
- My tutoring concentration lies on two subjects: Data Structures and Algorithms, and Operating Systems.

positions.title: Student Assistant for Diversity in STEM Outreach Program
positions.description:
- Worked in collaboration with the Women in Computing Society at New Jersey Institute of Technology and aid in the outreach program, by hosting events at High Schools with the aim to encourage female and underrepresented minority students to take up careers in Computing. 
- Conducted Python Coding workshops at a weekly basis for high and middle school students. 
-  Assisted as a guest lecturer to teach Java Programming at USMETS Coding club, NJ. 
- Trained new recruits to aid in their adaptability with stated job description by helping in improving their presentation, and communication skills.

positions.title: University Admissions Deparment Student Generalist
positions.description:
Working under this position for the University Admissions department, I performed the following tasks:
- Provided campus tours to aspiring students and their guardians.
- Aided in Virtual Open House sessions by interacting with prospective NJIT students and solving their queries related to the Computer Science Graduate program and International transition queries. 
- Performed clerical tasks involving opening mail, filing documents, performing scanning, document search that aids in smoothing the tasks for the Admission department at New Jersey Institute of Technology.
- Attended the help desk.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted Network Assisted Management and Local Remote Systems support using Kaseya Software.
- Performed Unified Cloud-based Management of mobile devices by using Cisco Meraki Management.
- Provided technical support, monitored, and maintained computer systems and networks.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a User Interface for SAP ABAP application using the SAPUI5 toolkit. Built User Interface using HTML5, JavaScript, and jQuery.
- Used Bootstrap, and programmed adaptive responsiveness to the website. Configured the UI to work for Web, and Mobile applications.

honors.title: Leadership Award
honors.description: Leadership award presented in recognition to the commitment shown towards the community and the organization for supporting and enlightening students about areas of Mathematics, Engineering, Technology, and Science.
honors.issuer: Issued by USMETS Coding Club · Aug 2016

projects.title: Supervised Data Mining - Classification Algorithm for Data Mining
projects.description:
- Implemented two classification algorithms Logistic Regression and Random Forest on a breast cancer dataset to predict probability of recurrence of cancer in a patient's body. The results of both the algorithms were compared using ROC graph and other Statistics.
- Logistic Regression was implemented using Orange Tool in Python. Using the tool, visualization charts for the results are generated.
- Random Forest algorithm was implemented using R programming in R studio.

projects.title: Apriori Algorithm for generating Association Rules for Item set Classification
projects.description:
- Implemented Apriori algorithm over transactional databases with item sets of various data types, and variable size using Java.
- Given an input text file, association rules are generated using as input user-defined support and confidence values. These rules help maximize the profit of sales by providing item sets that frequently occur together in transactions.
